$comment: Destinations allowed through the outbound firewall. Edit, then run `.devcontainer/firewall-ctl.sh reload` from the host — except host_ports, which is an iptables rule rather than an allow-list entry and needs `init`.
$comment_host_ports: TCP ports on the host machine itself, each allowed by its own iptables rule rather than through the address allow-list, which has no notion of a port. 3334 is the listener /usr/local/bin/host-editor forwards to. Changing this needs `firewall-ctl.sh init`, not `reload`.
